title: Conversion Credits and Lot Premium Deposit Terms for Homesite Reservations
content:
When a Homesite Reservation converts into a Home Purchase Agreement, the terms below apply by premium class.

| Premium class | Reservation deposit transfers as earnest money | Premium holding fee credited toward the lot premium deposit | Days after the reservation date during which the reserved lot premium is honored (calendar days) | Non-refundable lot premium deposit due when the purchase agreement is written (percent of the lot premium) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Interior Homesite | Yes | Yes | 30 | 0 |
| Corner Homesite | Yes | Yes | 30 | 0 |
| Cul-de-Sac Homesite | Yes | Yes | 30 | 25 |
| Greenbelt Homesite | Yes | Yes | 21 | 50 |
| Water-View Homesite | Yes | Yes | 21 | 50 |
| Golf-Frontage Homesite | Yes | Yes | 14 | 100 |

## Questions on the table

**Does the reservation deposit carry over?** For every class it transfers to the purchase agreement as earnest money on conversion.

**What does the lot premium deposit percent mean?** It is the percent of the lot premium due as a non-refundable lot premium deposit when the purchase agreement is written: nothing for Interior and Corner Homesites, a quarter for Cul-de-Sac Homesites, half for Greenbelt and Water-View Homesites, and the whole lot premium for Golf-Frontage Homesites.
